== Build notes ==
* The list is transcribed from Brandon Price's GEMP deck-builder screenshot (attachment 22609) in the 25 January 2026 post of [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86180 t=86180]. Each card was matched against the card scans and checked by eye; the list counts 60. The GEMP Download is generated from that list (the forum refused Price's exported .txt files, per his 25 December 2025 post).
* Bill Bisco confirmed on 19 October 2026 that these final versions are the decks every Prelude player had to use.
* <code>Card:</code> redirects for some Premiere cards (e.g. Card:1 234, Card:1 267, Card:1 289, Card:1 127, Card:1 128, Card:1 109) used to land on a redirect or a disambiguation page. Fixed 19 October 2026: 21 card-number redirects wiki-wide now point straight to the side-correct card page. This page links the card pages directly.

== Missing data ==
* t=86180 forum thread: hosted at swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86180.html and archived on Wayback 19 October 2026 (cited on the deck page).
* No Prelude standings or participant list on the wiki yet.
